Score

The deckard.score module defines scorer configuration objects used by model, attack, and experiment pipelines.

Scoring configuration primitives for Deckard models and attacks.

This module provides small wrappers around callable metrics and the default classifier/regressor scorer collections used throughout the experiment and model pipelines.

class deckard.score.DefaultClassifierDict[source]

Bases: object

Provides a default dictionary of scoring metrics for classification tasks.

scorers

A configuration object containing common classification scorers: - “accuracy”: Uses accuracy_score to measure overall accuracy. - “precision”: Uses precision_score with weighted averaging and zero_division=0. - “recall”: Uses recall_score with weighted averaging and zero_division=0. - “f1”: Uses f1_score with weighted averaging and zero_division=0. - “roc_auc”: Uses roc_auc_score with weighted averaging and multi-class ‘ovr’. - “log_loss”: Uses log_loss with optional label specification.

Type:

ScorerDictConfig

Usage
-----
This class is intended to provide a standardized set of scorers for evaluating classification models.
Each scorer is configurable via its associated `ScorerConfig`.

Example

>>> scorers = DefaultClassifierDict.scorers
>>> scorers["accuracy"].score_function(y_true, y_pred)
class deckard.score.DefaultRegressorDict[source]

Bases: object

Provides a default dictionary of regression scorers for model evaluation.

scorers
A configuration object containing standard regression metrics:

  • “mse”: Mean Squared Error (lower is better)

  • “mae”: Mean Absolute Error (lower is better)

  • “r2”: R^2 Score (higher is better)

Type:

ScorerDictConfig

Usage
-----
Used to supply common regression metrics for scoring models in Deckard.
class deckard.score.ScorerConfig(score_name, score_function, score_params=<factory>, greater_is_better=True, needs_proba=False)[source]

Bases: object

Wrap a metric callable together with its runtime parameters.

ScorerConfig is the atomic scoring unit used by ScorerDictConfig. It stores the metric name, the callable itself, and any static keyword arguments that should be supplied on every invocation.

class deckard.score.ScorerDictConfig(scorers)[source]

Bases: ConfigBase

Container of named ScorerConfig instances.

The object behaves like a small registry for metrics and is the public score configuration type accepted by experiments, models, and attacks.
